tools_used: WebFetch (supremecourt.gov PDFs) + local pdf text extraction
helpful: The provisioned snapshot carried the call for a response and the BIO entry, which drove the forecast.
CourtListener read_document delivered the lead case (Jules) in full within two calls.
gaps: The provisioned documents predate the brief in opposition and the supplemental brief; a re-fetch when a BIO lands would put the respondent's arguments in every predictor's baseline.
The salience band does not register a call for a response after a waiver, so the anchor is far below the state the docket actually shows; a CFR cut in the statpack would help.
CourtListener's opinion search did not index the Third Circuit opinion under review; I had to extract it from the petition appendix PDF.
The WebFetch summarizer cannot read PDFs; every supremecourt.gov brief needed a second local extraction step.
notes: Eleven retrieval calls beyond the corpus query (eight CourtListener MCP, three web fetches); well inside the advisory budget.
